rules: Field holdout is always isolated and never remapped into train/validation/test.
Recognized upstream train/validation/test semantics are preserved when they are mutually consistent inside a recording group.

If one protected recording group contains conflicting recognized upstream splits, the entire recording group is quarantined from development coverage and frozen corpus membership; individual clips are never remapped to manufacture a pass.
Quarantined assets remain durable source/ledger evidence and may be reconsidered only under a new audited split policy or corrected upstream identity evidence.
Unpartitioned groups use deterministic SHA-256 group hashing with the frozen seed.
All non-quarantined assets sharing recording_group_id receive exactly one ECHO split.
Exact or registered near-duplicate content may not cross protected split boundaries.
Changing seed, ratios, original split mapping, conflict strategy or grouping semantics requires a new audited policy identity.
